title: Ming Zhongdu Raman processing and screening code
description:
Raman processing and local-peak screening for historic pink-to-red lime finishes at Wumen Gate, Ming Zhongdu. The package contains 39 numerical raw spectra, four RRUFF reference spectra, the processing script and numerical reference outputs.

Coloured-point spectra from S1, S2 and S4 are compared with six spectra from the fresh white fracture of S2 (S2-FW). The workflow applies asymmetric least-squares baseline correction, five-point Savitzky–Golay smoothing, maximum normalisation and three-band screening near 225, 412 and 613 cm⁻¹. It also reports the sulfate marker near 1006 cm⁻¹, threshold sensitivity and the Raman figures.

Screening counts are S1 7/7, S2 9/9, S4 17/17 and S2-FW 0/6. Gypsum-related matches occur in 26 of 33 coloured-point spectra. RRUFF window matches are hematite 3/3, maghemite 2/3, magnetite 0/3 and goethite 0/3. Reference comparisons cover 39 screening rows, 24 sensitivity rows and 38,064 processed-spectrum rows.

Version 2.0.3: GitHub release.
